latencyLimitation: The effective Nginx access format has neither request_time nor upstream_response_time. Only the fixed monitor has elapsed values; no real-client backend latency percentile exists.
nextLogLimitation: The append-only Next files do not timestamp current entries, and no deployment-time byte offset was retained. File-wide pattern counts cannot be assigned honestly to either audit window and are excluded from the incident rate.

nginxErrorLog.interpretation: The six local port 3000 connection failures occurred during the deployment/reload interval and ended six seconds before the common window. The two later TLS handshake records never reached an HTTP application route.

statusVsPlaybackLimitation: Nginx 200 means an HTTP response status and observed bytes, not full MP3 decode, remaining-text closure, client queueing, or audible playback.
